decks.plan:
Win condition: Evolved Royal Hogs to destroy opponent's ground and air pressure.
Save 3 Elixir for 4-card Skeleton/Electro Spirit/Barbarian Barrel cycle.
Preferred lane: Top lane to pressure early with Bomb Tower and Goblinstein.
Defend Royal Hogs with Bomb Tower's 1.5 splash and early Skeletons.
Stop spending when opponent's 3+ Elixir push is blocked or Hogs are engaged.

update.plan:
Maintain top lane pressure with Bomb Tower and Goblinstein.
Use Electro Spirit to counter enemy air threats.
Deploy Royal Hogs with Skeletons for ground control.
Save 3 elixir for 4-card cycle to disrupt enemy pushes.
Defend Hogs with Bomb Tower’s splash if engaged.

decks.plan: Win by cycling and denying expansion through early pressure. Save 2nd spell for Wall Breakers to counter tower builds. Push the left lane with Archers and Magic Archer. Defend Graveyard with Skeletons and Fire Spirit to absorb swarms. Stop spending when opponent has no more towers to build.

update.plan:

Push left lane with Bats and Skeletons for wave control.
Defend Graveyard with Fire Spirit to absorb swarms.
Hold 2nd spell until enemy has no towers to build.

Stop spending when opponent's core is under pressure and 3+ cards are in play.
